row: Paisley's Corner - Educational Videos for Kids

Come learn through play with Silly Miss Lily in fun, family-friendly educational videos for kids. From baby and toddler learning to ages 1–5 and beyond, Paisley’s Corner offers fun learning adventures that are calm, engaging, and meaningful.

We explore science concepts like gravity, inertia, helicopters, and geodes, plus teach first words, baby sign language, ABCs, colors, shapes, nursery rhymes, and early reading, all in a safe, non-overstimulating space.

Created by a mom of two, homeschool teacher, and University of Washington business graduate, every video is thoughtfully designed to be educational, interactive, and parent-approved.

💡 Gentle but engaging, our videos use repetition, pretend play, and simple activities to help toddlers and preschoolers learn naturally through play.

We believe kids are capable of learning so much, and when learning feels fun and calm, it sticks.

Subscribe for family-friendly learning videos, toddler learning, and fun educational adventures 💛
